This is a lesson on one drum groove the [Backing Track](../../tools/backing-track.qmd) band plays: **Reggae one-drop**. It is built up from 2 simpler patterns, one step at a time, and every step is played by the band and written out as it plays. How the examples work: press ▶ Play, switch players in and out with the buttons beside it, and read what the band will play on the staff underneath: the whole pass is written out when Play starts, before it sounds. The tempo slider at the bottom of the page slows everything down.

[All the accompaniment patterns](index.qmd) · [Drum grooves](index.qmd#drums)

## The pattern

Nothing on beat 1. Kick and cross-stick together on beat 3, with cymbal eighths that lean on the off-beats.

It belongs in *Ska / reggae*. Here it is in the ska / reggae style with the whole band. Switch the other players off to hear it alone.

## Step 1: Hi-hat: eighth notes

Start with something simpler. Closed hi-hat on every eighth note, all of one weight, kick on 1 and 3, snare on 2 and 4. The basic rock beat. In 3/4: six eighths, kick on 1, snare on 3.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](drums-hheighths.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums play alone first; switch the bass and chords on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="reggae" data-chart="C|F|G|C" data-tempo="56" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Hi-hat: eighth notes","opts":{"groove":"hheighths"}}]'></div>

## Step 2: Half-time

The backbeat at half speed: kick on 1 and the and of 2, one snare on beat 3.

This is a pattern of its own: [the lesson on it](drums-halftime.qmd) takes it further. Here it is only a step on the way, slowly. The drums play alone first; switch the bass and chords on when it is steady.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="reggae" data-chart="C|F|G|C" data-tempo="56" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Step:" data-choices='[{"label":"Half-time","opts":{"groove":"halftime"}}]'></div>

## Step 3: Reggae one-drop, slowly

Now the pattern itself. Compare it with the step before: press each button while the band plays and watch what changes on the staff.

**How to play it.** Nothing on beat 1. Kick and cross-stick together on beat 3, cymbal eighths leaning on the off-beats. The silence on 1 is the style.

<div class="ar-demo" data-style="reggae" data-chart="C|F|G|C" data-tempo="56" data-on="drums" data-staves="drums" data-choice-label="Compare:" data-choices='[{"label":"Reggae one-drop","opts":{"groove":"onedrop"}},{"label":"Half-time (the step before)","opts":{"groove":"halftime"}}]'></div>

## Step 4: Up to tempo, with the band

The whole band, at 80 beats a minute. Play along, then switch the band's drum kit off and take the part yourself.
